purpose: Record the first evidence-backed end-to-end capability-escalation chain without pretending that an external collaborator was actually invoked.
verified_existing_capabilities: capability routing can choose SELF, DELEGATE or STOP under zero-cost/privacy constraints
delegated work can be packaged for handoff
returned collaborator receipts can be rejected for unknown/nonzero cost, privacy failure, missing identity/provenance/output/completion, missing independent verification, or contradiction
verified receipts may only become INTEGRATE_CANDIDATE and cannot write Stable
not_yet_claimed: automatic discovery of a real external AI or human collaborator

next_functional_target.name: provider-neutral collaborator transport adapter
next_functional_target.requirement: turn a DELEGATE handoff package into an actual zero-cost collaborator call when a permitted connector exists, while failing closed when unavailable, paid, privacy-incompatible, or unverifiable

organ_routing.DROPLET: discover candidate collaborators and record availability/cost/privacy/provenance
organ_routing.MUTHER: read-decompose-recombine-mutate task decomposition and handoff formulation
organ_routing.GUT: integrate only verified returned material as candidate
organ_routing.VAJRA: audit cost/privacy/provenance/contradiction and block unsupported claims
organ_routing.SHROOMING: observe whether delegation wiring persists across unrelated real workloads without Stable contamination
